corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from airflow.models.dagbag import DagBag

router = APIRouter(prefix="/airflow/dags")

@router.get("/{dag_id}/structure")
async def get_dag_structure(
    dag_id: str,
    dag_bag: DagBag = Depends(get_dag_bag),
    tenant_catalog: TenantDagCatalog = Depends(get_tenant_dag_catalog),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if not tenant_catalog.verify_dag_ownership(dag_id, current_user.tenant_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: You do not own this DAG")

    dag = dag_bag.get_dag(dag_id)
    if not dag:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="DAG not found in DagBag")

    return {
        "dag_id": dag_id,
        "schedule_interval": str(dag.schedule_interval),
        "task_ids": [t.task_id for t in dag.tasks],
        "catchup": dag.catchup
    }
